title: Handoff to development

body.text: A good handoff reduces back-and-forth — have Claude help write
a spec developers can actually use: behavior for every state, sizes/spacing, edge cases
— like what the button looks like while loading, what an empty list shows, how overly long text is truncated.

example: "From this form design, write a dev spec: every state (default, focus, error, disabled, loading) and the validation rules"

title: Claude Design course wrap-up

body.text: brief, mood board, UX copy, color, brand voice, design system, Figma, critique, and handoff
— AI doesn't replace a designer's eye, but it clears away the paperwork and repetitive work so you can spend your time on the truly creative parts.

example: "Capstone: pick one design task on your plate, use AI from brief to handoff, then compare the time to your old way"
